import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
src0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
src1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
src2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
src3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
src4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
src5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
src6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/training_6.csv", index_col=0)

# Union all source tables (concatenate rows)
df = pd.concat([src0, src1, src2, src3, src4, src5, src6], ignore_index=True)

# Group by leftmost non-float unique columns from target schema:
# According to target schema and hints:
# Group by columns: matricula (float but unique id), nome_discente (string), sexo (string), ano_ingresso (int),
# forma_ingresso (string), tipo_discente (string), status (string), sigla_nivel_ensino (string),
# nivel_ensino (string), nome_curso (string), modalidade_educacao (string), nome_unidade (string), nome_unidade_gestora (string)
# Aggregate max for float columns not in group by: periodo_ingresso, id_curso, id_unidade, id_unidade_gestora

group_by_cols = [
    "matricula",
    "nome_discente",
    "sexo",
    "ano_ingresso",
    "forma_ingresso",
    "tipo_discente",
    "status",
    "sigla_nivel_ensino",
    "nivel_ensino",
    "nome_curso",
    "modalidade_educacao",
    "nome_unidade",
    "nome_unidade_gestora"
]

agg_dict = {
    "periodo_ingresso": "max",
    "id_curso": "max",
    "id_unidade": "max",
    "id_unidade_gestora": "max"
}

df_final = df.groupby(group_by_cols, dropna=False, as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'matricula', 'nome_discente', 'sexo', 'ano_ingresso', 'periodo_ingresso', 'forma_ingresso',
    'tipo_discente', 'status', 'sigla_nivel_ensino', 'nivel_ensino', 'id_curso', 'nome_curso',
    'modalidade_educacao', 'id_unidade', 'nome_unidade', 'id_unidade_gestora', 'nome_unidade_gestora'
]

df_final = df_final[target_columns]

# Write output CSV
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_79/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
